mapper.sql: boardid, user_id, title, content, cnt, like_cnt, created_at, modified_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO board ( user_id, title, content, cnt, like_cnt, created_at, modified_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{cnt}, #{likeCnt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) )
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM board ORDER BY created_at DESC, boardid DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT
FROM board ORDER BY cnt DESC, created_at DESC, boardid DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT b.boardid, b.user_id, b.title, b.content, b.cnt, b.like_cnt, b.created_at, b.modified_at FROM board b LEFT JOIN reply r ON r.board_id = b.boardid GROUP BY b.boardid, b.user_id, b.title, b.content, b.cnt, b.like_cnt, b.created_at, b.modified_at ORDER BY COUNT(r.reply_id) DESC, b.created_at DESC, b.boardid DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT
FROM board WHERE title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY created_at DESC, boardid DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM board WHERE title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
mapper.update: UPDATE board SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, modified_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE boardid = #{boardid}
